wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Foglio1']
# columns G..P = 7..16, header row1 has 10..1
for r in range(2, 19):

            f'(ROW(DATI!\$J\$2:\$J\$78)-1)/(DATI!\$K\$2:\$K\$78=\$E{r}),'
            f'{col_}\$1))'
        )
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
